goal: Faster, observable and auditable Biz report pulls in the VII admin.

intent_model.literal_request: Long date searches are opaque and can take twenty minutes; preserve action history per user.
intent_model.implied_outcome: An operator can understand, trust and later prove every report pull without waiting through an unexplained spinner.
likely_rejections: Only the speed changes but history is still lost.
History exists but does not identify the user or requested range.
A progress bar moves without matching persisted counts.

interpretation_rules.phrase: חייב להיות היסטוריה פעולות לכל משתמש
interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Persist actor-attributed report run records shared across authorized administration sessions.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Require save, reload, ownership and authorization checks.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Current pull status and percent complete.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Continue, stop safely, or use already saved results.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Review the completed run in history or retry only failed/missing data.
deferred_complexity: Per-business diagnostics remain available in the detailed report.
preserved_depth: Actor, period, scope, success/failure totals, timestamps and forced-refresh flag remain visible in history.

predictive_preflight.midpoint_requirement: Persist and reload the first complete run slice.
predictive_preflight.adversarial_requirement: Attack ownership, interrupted progress, reload and bounded concurrency.
predictive_preflight.effectiveness_requirement: Measure wave size, stored fields and reload survival.

facts.claim: The current client processes groups of four sequentially.
facts.evidence: app/admin/business-performance/page.tsx before this change used offset += 4 and slice(offset, offset + 4).

facts.claim: The current batch state is client memory only.
facts.evidence: The current page stores bizBatchJob and bizBatchProgress only in React state.

assumptions.claim: Twelve concurrent supplier reads are a safe initial bounded increase.
assumptions.validation: Keep a hard server cap of twelve and verify failures remain isolated per target.

out_of_scope: Inventing history for actions completed before deployment
invariants: No supplier token or contact PII in history
Admin authorization and origin validation remain
Last good aggregate snapshots remain intact
affected_family: vacations, events and hourly conversion families

requirements.statement: Process report targets materially faster with bounded parallelism.
Show understandable live progress for the current pull.
Persist an attributable run record for every admin user.
Preserve truthful stop, failure and reload states.

acceptance_checks.setup: A report has more than twelve supported targets.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The client submits waves of twelve and the server rejects larger waves.
Processed count, total and percentage update after each wave.

acceptance_checks.setup: An authorized admin starts and completes a pull.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: History shows the same actor, period, scope, status and counts.

acceptance_checks.setup: One admin owns an active run.
acceptance_checks.action: A different admin attempts to stop it.

acceptance_checks.setup: A run is interrupted for more than thirty minutes.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: It is shown as interrupted, not completed.
The additive history table does not break the previous report and cached summaries remain usable.

acceptance_checks.setup: One or more supplier targets fail inside a wave.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Progress continues, failed targets are counted separately, successful saved data remains visible, and the run does not claim every target succeeded.

open_questions.question: Whether Biz can later expose one aggregate endpoint for all businesses.
open_questions.resolution: Reconsider bounded fan-out if the supplier publishes an official bulk contract.

authorization_boundary: Local candidate implementation and verification; public deployment still requires explicit authorization.
